create_dinat_configuration: create a DinatConfig instance with default settings for the shi-labs/dinat-mini-in1k-224 model
initialize_dinat_model: initialize a DinatModel with a DinatConfig instance for random weight initialization
customize_dinat_patch_size: customize the DinatConfig patch_size parameter to a different integer or tuple value
set_dinat_dilation_values: set custom dilation values for each NA layer in the DinatConfig dilations parameter
configure_dinat_model_depths: configure DinatConfig with custom depths, num_heads, and embed_dim values for a deeper model
